metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Thailand between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products - FIRMS data: MODIS Collection 6 (MOD14A1/MYD14A1) or VIIRS 375m - Better to use MODIS/006/MOD14A1 and MYD14A1 daily fire products - Date range: 2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28 - Locations: Cambodia and Thailand boundaries 2. Masking strategy: - Fire products have confidence bands - should filter for high confidence detections - Use FireMask band where values >7 typically indicate fire 3. Logic: - Count total fire detections in each country - Compare Cambodia vs Thailand counts - Valid zero means no fires detected (legitimate result) -> Answer A or B - C1: No images in collection - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Cambodia and Thailand const cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')) .geometry(); const thailand = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Thailand')) .geometry(); // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2016-08-01'; const endDate = '2018-02-28'; // 3. Load MODIS fire products (Terra and Aqua) const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1')) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('FireMask'); const collectionSize = modis.size().getInfo(); console.log('Total MODIS fire images:', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No fire detection images found in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Create binary fire mask (FireMask values 7-9 indicate fire) const fireMask = modis.map(function(img) { const fire = img.gte(7).and(img.lte(9)); return fire.selfMask(); }); // 5. Sum all fire detections for Cambodia const cambodiaFireSum = fireMask.sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: cambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cambodiaCount = cambodiaFireSum.get('FireMask').getInfo(); // 6. Sum all fire detections for Thailand const thailandFireSum = fireMask.sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: thailand, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const thailandCount = thailandFireSum.get('FireMask').getInfo(); // 7. Validation console.log('Cambodia fire detections:', cambodiaCount); console.log('Thailand fire detections:', thailandCount); if (cambodiaCount === null || thailandCount === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(cambodiaCount) || isNaN(thailandCount)) { console.log('Calculation failed - NaN result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare and answer if (cambodiaCount > thailandCount) { console.log('Cambodia had more active fire detections'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Thailand had equal or more active fire detections'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
